info.name: HMS Backend API
info.description:
Postman collection for implemented HMS Backend APIs only.

Base URL: http://localhost:5094

Auth: most routes need a Bearer token from Staff Login. Create organization/property require a PLATFORM_ADMIN token.

Enums are sent as numbers (ASP.NET default):
- PropertyType: Hotel=0, Guesthouse=1, Villa=2, Apartment=3, Hostel=4, Homestay=5, Resort=6, Campsite=7, Lodge=8, Bungalow=9, Other=10
- PropertyStatus: Draft=0, Active=1, Suspended=2, Closed=3
- UnitKind: Room=0, Villa=1, Apartment=2, Cabin=3, Tent=4, DormBed=5, Cottage=6, EntireProperty=7, Other=8
- AccommodationUnitStatus: Available=0, Occupied=1, OutOfService=2, Maintenance=3, Inactive=4
- HousekeepingStatus: Clean=0, Dirty=1, Inspected=2, InProgress=3, NotApplicable=4
- UnitBlockType: Maintenance=0, OwnerUse=1, Closed=2, Other=3
- PricingBasis: PerRoomPerNight=0, PerPersonPerNight=1, PerBedPerNight=2, FlatPerStay=3
- GuestType: Individual=0, Couple=1, Family=2, Group=3, Corporate=4, TravelAgent=5
- DocumentType: Nic=0, Passport=1, DrivingLicence=2, Other=3
- PreferenceType: Room=0, Dietary=1, Accessibility=2, Communication=3, Other=4
- dayOfWeek: Sunday=0 through Saturday=6, or null for all days

request.description: Dummy platform super admin. Email: superadmin@hms.local / Password: SuperAdmin@123. Returns PLATFORM_ADMIN JWT. No database user.

Same endpoint for SuperAdmin, admin, and staff. Send the refreshToken from any login. Returns a new access token and a new refresh token. The previous refresh token is revoked. Call this when the access token expires.

Requires PLATFORM_ADMIN. Creates or reuses the admin for this property (login is email + password). Emails the Admin Login URL, email, temporary password, and instructions to reset password after first login. Email cannot be changed later.

If SMTP fails, response includes emailSent=false and temporaryPassword.
Requires PLATFORM_ADMIN. Lists hotel admins assigned to the property. adminId is the staffUid returned by Invite Property Admin.
Requires PLATFORM_ADMIN. Returns one hotel admin for this property.
Requires PLATFORM_ADMIN. Updates first name, last name, and active flag. Email cannot be changed. Setting isActive false disables login.
Requires PLATFORM_ADMIN. Removes the admin from this property. Returns 204. The login account is deleted only when the person has no other property assignment.
Requires PLATFORM_ADMIN token. Creates HOTEL_ADMIN for the property. Login uses email + password (no username).
Hotel admin / manager login with email + password. propertyUid is optional. Response includes propertyUids. After first invite login, call Reset Admin Password.
Requires HOTEL_ADMIN / MANAGER token. Resets password only. Email cannot be changed. staffUid stays the same.
Requires PLATFORM_ADMIN or HOTEL_ADMIN token. Allowed roles: FRONT_DESK, HOUSEKEEPING, RESTAURANT, BAR, CASHIER.
Operational staff login with email + password. Also available at POST /api/hotel/auth/login. propertyUid is optional.
Lists properties the signed-in staff user can access.
POST /api/v1/platform/organizations. code and name are required.

item.name: 03 - Properties
item.description: Properties belong under organizations. Only PLATFORM_ADMIN (SuperAdmin) can create or list organization properties.

request.description: Requires PLATFORM_ADMIN. Lists all non-archived properties for the organization.
Requires PLATFORM_ADMIN. propertyType 0 = Hotel.

request.description: Archives the meal plan. Returns 204. Rate plans that already reference it keep the link. Requires manager access.
pricingBasis 0 = PerRoomPerNight. mealPlanUid is optional; set null if unused.
Returns one active rate plan. Anyone with access to its property can call it.

Updates code, name, pricing basis, currency, description, and refundable flag. Accommodation type and meal plan stay as they were. Code must stay unique for the property. pricingBasis PerRoomPerNight=0, PerPersonPerNight=1, PerBedPerNight=2, FlatPerStay=3. Requires manager access.
Archives the rate plan. Returns 204. Existing prices stay linked. Requires manager access.
endDate must be on or after startDate. dayOfWeek 0-6 or null. unitRate >= 0, minimumStay > 0.

item.name: 08 - Guests
item.description: Guests belong to the property's organization. Accessed via propertyUid.

request.description: Optional search matches display name, first/last name, phone, or email.
guestType 0 = Individual. displayName is required unless first/last name can be combined. Requires manager access.
Requires manager access to a property in the guest's organization.
At least one of phone, name, or email is required.
documentType 0 = NIC. Number must be unique per organization and type.
preferenceType 0 = Room. Requires hotel.guest_preferences (run 003_guest_preferences.sql if the original schema is already applied).

item.name: 09 - Property Bookings
item.description: Property bookings. Requires property access. Creating a booking requires manager access.

request.description: Returns each unit with overlapping BOOKING and BLOCK segments. from is inclusive and to is exclusive. Optional accommodationTypeUid filters the units. Range cannot exceed 366 days.
bookingSource Direct=3. pricingBasis PerRoomPerNight=0. unitUid is optional. Status is PENDING. Requires manager access.
status Confirmed=3, CheckedIn=4, CheckedOut=5, Cancelled=7. Cancellation requires cancellationReason. Status changes are written to booking_status_history. Requires manager access.
Sets status to CONFIRMED and marks held units as CONFIRMED. Requires manager access. Inquiry, pending, and tentative bookings can be confirmed.
Only a CONFIRMED booking can be checked in. Sets status CHECKED_IN, stores checked_in_at on the booking and its guests, and sets unit allocation to CHECKED_IN. Requires manager access.
Only a CHECKED_IN booking can be checked out. Sets status CHECKED_OUT, stores checked_out_at on the booking and its guests, and releases the units. Requires manager access.

Assigns a physical unit to one booking unit line. The unit must match the line's accommodation type. Overlapping active bookings return a conflict. Allocation stays HELD, CONFIRMED, or CHECKED_IN based on the booking status. Requires manager access.
Adds an existing organization guest to the booking. bookingUnitUid is optional. isLeadGuest true replaces the current lead guest. Requires manager access.
Archives the guest on this booking. The lead guest cannot be removed until another lead is assigned. Returns 204. Requires manager access.
Returns the created event plus every row in booking_status_history, oldest first. Anyone with property access can call it.
Sets status to CANCELLED, stores the reason, and releases held or confirmed units. Requires manager access.

paymentMethod Cash=0, BankTransfer=1, Card=2, Cheque=3, Other=4. Category and optional supplier must belong to the property organization. Optional booking must belong to the property. Amount must be greater than zero. Requires manager access.
Requires manager access. Category, supplier, and booking rules match create.
Archives the expense. Returns 204. Requires manager access.

Utility type must belong to the property organization. periodEnd must be on or after periodStart. Amount cannot be negative. If both readings are sent, units used is current minus previous. Requires manager access.
Requires manager access. Same period, reading, and amount rules as create. Utility type must belong to the bill's organization.

Income category must belong to the property organization. Optional booking must belong to the property. Amount must be greater than zero. paymentMethod Cash=0, BankTransfer=1, Card=2, Cheque=3, Other=4. Requires manager access.
Returns the organization expense categories for the property. Use uid as expenseCategoryUid when creating an expense.

Creates an organization expense category through the property. expenseGroup Staff=0, Utility=1, Food=2, Maintenance=3, Transport=4, Marketing=5, Supplies=6, Administration=7, Other=8. parentUid is optional and must be another category in the same organization. Code is unique per organization. Requires manager access. Saves uid as expenseCategoryUid.

item.name: 12 - Payments
item.description: Booking charges, payments, refunds, financial summary, and invoice. Implemented in the Payments module.

request.description: Reads hotel.vw_booking_financial_summary. totalBookingValue is room revenue plus extra charges, minus the booking discount, plus tax and service charge. outstandingBalance is totalBookingValue minus completed payments plus completed refunds. Anyone with property access can call it.

Builds an invoice from the financial summary, property, lead guest, active room lines, charges, payments, and refunds. invoiceNumber is {invoiceNumberPrefix}-{bookingNumber}. Totals match the financial summary. Anyone with property access can call it.
Lists active charges for the booking. Total is stored by the database as round((quantity * unit_price) - discount + tax, 2). Anyone with property access can call it.
Adds a charge. chargeTypeUid must be an active booking_charge_types row for the same property. Total amount is generated and cannot be sent. Requires manager access.
Updates an active charge. Requires manager access.
Archives the charge. Returns 204. Requires manager access.
Lists active payments. paymentMethod: CASH, BANK_TRANSFER, CARD, ONLINE_GATEWAY, CHEQUE, OTHER. paymentType: DEPOSIT, PAYMENT, ADJUSTMENT. Anyone with property access can call it.

Adds a payment. Enums are numbers: method Cash=0, BankTransfer=1, Card=2, OnlineGateway=3, Cheque=4, Other=5. Type Deposit=0, Payment=1, Adjustment=2. Status Pending=0, Completed=1, Failed=2, Cancelled=3. Requires manager access.
Refunds a completed payment. Amount cannot exceed the remaining balance after pending and completed refunds. Returns 201. Requires manager access.

item.name: 13 - Reports
item.description: Property reports from the Reports module.

request.description: Reads hotel.vw_monthly_property_summary for the first day of the given month. Booking income includes confirmed, checked-in, checked-out, and completed bookings by check-in month. Staff and utility costs come from their own tables; other expenses exclude STAFF and UTILITY groups. A month with no activity returns zeros. Anyone with property access can call it.

Lists active bookings from hotel.vw_booking_financial_summary, newest check-in first. totalBookingValue is room revenue plus extra charges, minus the booking discount, plus tax and service charge. paymentsReceived and refundsPaid count completed rows only. Anyone with property access can call it.

Lists hotel.vw_booking_profitability for the property, newest check-in first. estimatedProfit is total booking value minus direct expenses and allocated overhead. profitPerGuestNight is null when there are no adults or children, or no nights. Anyone with property access can call it.
Sums booking profitability by lead guest. A booking is counted once, on its lead guest. Anyone with property access can call it.
Lists guest stays from hotel.vw_guest_booking_history, newest check-in first. Anyone with property access can call it.
Reads hotel.vw_payment_method_summary for completed payments in the given month. One row per payment method and currency. Anyone with property access can call it.
Lists bookings from hotel.vw_booking_financial_summary whose outstanding balance is greater than zero. Anyone with property access can call it.
Staff, utility, and general expenses for the month from hotel.vw_monthly_property_summary. A month with no activity returns zeros. Anyone with property access can call it.
Reads hotel.vw_monthly_utility_summary for the given month, one row per utility type. Anyone with property access can call it.

item.name: 14 - Staff
item.description: Property staff, work logs, and staff payments. staffRoleUid must already exist in hotel.staff_roles for the property organization.

request.description: Lists active staff for the property. Anyone with property access can call it.

employmentType Monthly=0, Daily=1, Hourly=2, Contract=3. status Active=0, OnLeave=1, Left=2, Suspended=3. Staff role must belong to the property organization. Employee number is unique per property. Requires manager access.
Anyone with access to the staff member's property can call it.
Same fields and role rules as create. Requires manager access.
Optional bookingUid must belong to the same property. Hours cannot be negative. Returns 201. Requires manager access.
Lists active work logs, newest work date first. Anyone with property access can call it.
totalPaid is calculated as basic + overtime + bonus - deduction and is not sent. paymentMethod Cash=0, BankTransfer=1, Card=2, Cheque=3, Other=4. Returns 201. Requires manager access.
Lists active staff payments for the property, newest first. Anyone with property access can call it.
